numeric_precision.description: Numeric precision (total number of digits) for the column. Only checked by schema validation if specified and supported by the data source.

additional.description: One more threshold on the same metric, with its own level. It holds exactly one comparison and an optional level, and its level must differ from the level of the threshold it is nested in.

threshold_rules.description: Constraints shared by threshold and thresholdFreshness. (1) A threshold that carries an additional threshold specifies exactly one flat must_be_* comparison itself, and so does that additional threshold; a threshold without an additional threshold is not constrained in arity, so a legacy threshold with several flat comparisons still validates (the engine builds no threshold from it). (2) The level of the threshold and the level of its additional threshold must differ, where an absent level means fail. Each rule is an if/then whose then denies the additional property: that failure shape carries errorMessage in the YAML editor (which ignores errorMessage on not, oneOf and if) and puts the marker on the additional key.

allOf.description: A threshold with an additional threshold carries exactly one flat must_be_* comparison itself. Every alternative repeats its key under properties: without a property match the editor language service drops its multiple-match report and a second comparison would go unflagged.

then.errorMessage: A threshold that has an additional threshold must itself have exactly one comparison (one must_be_* key, or one must_be_between / must_be_not_between range).

message.false: {0}: A threshold that has an additional threshold must itself have exactly one comparison (one must_be_* key, or one must_be_between / must_be_not_between range).

allOf.description: The additional threshold holds exactly one comparison. The alternatives repeat their key under properties for the same reason as the rule above.

then.errorMessage: additional takes exactly one comparison: one must_be_* key, or one must_be_between / must_be_not_between range.

message.false: {0}: additional takes exactly one comparison: one must_be_* key, or one must_be_between / must_be_not_between range.

allOf.description: A threshold and its additional threshold cannot both be fail-level (the level of a threshold without a level).

then.errorMessage: A threshold and its additional threshold must have different levels: one fail, one warn. A threshold without a level is fail.
